verdict.rationale: Docs confirm official client SDKs and event-sending guides (mparticle-docs-1, -2, -17) plus a dedicated identity-resolution framework (mparticle-docs-x1) that maps to identify(), and 'Send events directly' implies server-side/API ingestion. However the evidence never explicitly names a track/identify/page spec or enumerates web, mobile, and server SDK coverage in detail.  Missing for 10: explicit spec naming (track/identify/page terminology), confirmation of server-side SDK support, and independent corroboration of SDK behavior beyond docs.
